summary: KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a declared dividend of $9.74 per share on its common shares, payable on or about May 29, 2026 to shareholders of record as of April 30, 2026. No tender offer, acquisition, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
